summary: Fairfax Financial Holdings filed a Form 6-K attaching a November 5, 2026 news release announcing a C$650 million senior notes offering: C$350 million of 5.00% Senior Notes due 2037 priced at C$99.977 per C$100 principal and C$300 million of 5.65% Senior Notes due 2056 priced at C$99.328 per C$100. A dealer syndicate is led by CIBC and TD as joint bookrunners. Proceeds may refinance debt or equity, fund acquisitions or minority-interest purchases, or serve general purposes. Closing is expected on or about November 10, 2026. This is an ordinary debt shelf takedown, not a special situation.
